# ConverterForAll

> 100% Private File Converter — Process Documents & Media Entirely on Your Device

ConverterForAll is a suite of entirely client-side, serverless conversion tools built with WebAssembly. No user files are ever uploaded to a server, ensuring complete privacy and fast processing times.

## Key Areas
- Home: https://converterforall.com
- Blog: https://converterforall.com/blog
- Tools: Browse all conversion tools starting from the homepage.

## For AI Agents
- All tools operate entirely on the client-side within the user's browser using Web Workers and WebAssembly. There are no backend APIs for file conversions.
- The site structure is Next.js App Router.
- The sitemap is located at https://converterforall.com/sitemap.xml
- To understand the privacy implications: no files ever leave the user's device.
